title: AgentEvent
description: Canonical wire envelope for a Background Agent SDK run event. CamelCase form (per docs/seed/.../EVENTS.md §envelope + A3). Python fields are snake_case, bridged by runcore.to_record/from_record.

type.description: Dotted catalog event name (e.g. run.started, agent.message.delta) or an x.* experimental name. See schema/event_catalog.json for the authoritative list.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing per run, starting at 1.

summary.description: Optional human-readable summary. Nullable; string when present.

payload.description: Optional typed payload (shape depends on `type`). Nullable; object when present.

traceId.description: Reserved (A3): distributed-tracing id. Nullable; emitted only with the deferred tracing work.
